subject: Request: Increase trial credits for FinLytics POC (32k context / high TPM)
messages:
From: Anna Kim <anna.kim@finlytics.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 09:12:05 -0800
Subject: Trial limits—requesting larger free credits for POC

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the model latency and cost numbers looked promising. We are kicking off a two-week POC next Monday and realized the current PLG trial credits won’t cover our expected token usage. Our POC uses ~32k context windows for long-document summarization and an expected peak of ~120 requests/min (high TPM).

Estimate: ~9–12M tokens total for the POC (mostly long seq tokens). Can Redwood temporarily increase the initial free credits or issue a promo code to cover this scope? We’re trying to avoid starting behind on evaluation.

Attached is the POC plan (high-level). Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Anna Kim
Head of Data Science, FinLytics
Attachments: finlytics_poc_plan.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Anna Kim <anna.kim@finlytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 2 Nov 2025 10:05:12 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trial limits—requesting larger free credits for POC

Hi Anna — thanks for sending the plan, this looks like a solid POC. Short answer: we can increase the self-serve credits in many cases, but for a one-off increase of this size I need to confirm with growth/finance so we stay within promo policy.

Can you confirm two quick items so I can make the request:
- POC start/end dates (you mentioned Monday — what day does it end?)
- Which region will you run in (us-west / eu-west / ap-south)?

If you prefer a faster path, we can issue a time-limited promo code that unlocks X tokens. Will follow up once internal approvals come through.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, michael_grant@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: FinLytics POC — promo credit request

Rafael — forwarding FinLytics' request. They need a temporary bump to cover ~9–12M tokens for a two-week POC (32k context, ~120 TPM peak). Vanessa confirmed they’ll run in us-west and start 2025-11-10, end 2025-11-24.

Recommendation: approve a one-time promo for 10M tokens (estimate) expiring 2025-12-01. FinLytics is an active PLG lead with clear expansion potential — this is within our growth playbook for POCs of this scale.

Please confirm if finance needs a promo code value instead of tokens (we can provide an approximate $ credit). Also flag if we should route to legal / compliance — I don’t think so for this size.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Growth
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: michael_grant@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:40:22 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: FinLytics POC — promo credit request

Marissa — I’m OK to approve a one-time increase. Couple of ops asks before I issue the promo:
- Confirm billing account id or HubSpot account id so we tie usage to FinLytics (deal FD-2025-112-POC).
- Do we want to set a hard token cap (recommended) and an expiry date (recommended).
- If they’re running 32k context, per-token cost is higher — recommend issuing a $2,500 credit (equivalent to ~10M tokens at the average promo rate) to keep accounting simple.

Michael — can you confirm if $2,500 consumes an approval tier or if I can issue from my queue? If not, Michael can sign-off and we’ll create promo code FINLYTICS-POC-112.

Rafael
Sales Ops
From: michael_grant@redwood.ai
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 10:41:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: FinLytics POC — promo credit request

Rafael — approved. $2,500 one-time credit is within my approval threshold. Please issue promo code and set expiration 2025-12-01 and a hard cap to avoid runaway spend. Also include these guardrails in the promo metadata:
- Applies only to FinLytics billing account / HubSpot ID FD-2025-112-POC
- Usable in us-west region only
- Non-renewing, single-use code

Rafael — once you create the code, please return the code and the redemption instructions and I’ll note it in the finance tracker.

Michael Grant
Director, Finance Operations
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Anna Kim <anna.kim@finlytics.com>, Eric Zhou <eric.zhou@finlytics.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, michael_grant@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 10:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trial limits—requesting larger free credits for POC

Hi Anna / Eric — good news: finance approved a one-time trial credit for your POC. Details below.

Promo code: FINLYTICS-POC-112
Credit: $2,500 (covers estimated ~10M tokens for 32k context workloads)
Expiry: 2025-12-01 23:59 UTC
Region: us-west only
Usage cap: $2,500 / single redemption for account FD-2025-112-POC

How to redeem:
1) Log into your account console -> Billing -> Apply promo code (or use the billing API: POST /v1/billing/promos/redeem with code).
2) Confirm region is set to us-west before starting the POC.
3) If you need the code applied to a different billing id, let us know and we’ll coordinate with finance.

A few notes / guardrails from finance: the credit is non-renewing and intended for evaluation only. If you expect to expand beyond the POC, let’s set up a quick sync with our solutions team to discuss Dedicated options and estimated committed capacity.

I’ve attached the POC plan for our records. Good luck with the run — ping me if you hit any throttle or need to increase.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: finlytics_poc_plan.pdf
